---
title: "Prepare, approve and publish a one-off CVD report"
description: "Operate the controlled three-step publication route for a finished bespoke report."
manual-review-status: not-reviewed
---

## Before the controlled workflow

Complete and document the bespoke analysis. The common workflow begins with a
finished PDF; it does not run, standardise or reproduce the analytical method.
Use a stable lowercase study ID containing letters, numbers and underscores.

## Step 1: Prepare the candidate

Choose **User > BNR > One-off CVD report publication > Step 1: Prepare one-off
report candidate**. Supply the study ID, positive report version, finished PDF,
public title, description and report date. Confirm that the private candidate
contains the PDF, `index.qmd` and `report.yml`.

## Step 2: Approve the candidate

Choose **Step 2: Approve one-off report candidate**. Identify the authorised
approver and complete the candidate, disclosure and readiness confirmations.
Approval creates the exact manifested `public_ready` payload and
`approval.yml`; it does not publish.

## Step 3: Publish the report

Choose **Step 3: Publish approved one-off report** for the same study ID and
version. Confirm verification and inspect the authoritative PDF, website mirror,
landing page and metadata. A correction requires a higher approved version at
the same stable study location.

## Disclosure screen {#disclosure-screen}

The optional utility is available at **User > BNR > Report utilities > Screen
report counts for disclosure review**. Its input must contain `output_id`,
`cell_id` and numeric `cell_count`. It flags counts from zero to five, missing,
negative or non-integer counts and duplicate identifiers.

The screen does not change the source dataset, apply secondary suppression or
approve the report. Its output remains private review evidence. The analyst must
review the complete proposed report for direct and indirect disclosure risk.
